observed_value: cost_currency populated as CAD/EUR/GBP on flagged rows
anchor_value: source table places CAD/EUR/GBP before Par Amount /Units; Cost (3) and Fair Value are separate columns

culprit_citations.quoted_text: Investments-non-controlled/ non-affiliated (1) | Footnotes | Reference Rate and Spread | Interest Rate (2) | Maturity Date | Par Amount /Units | Cost (3) | Fair Value | % of Net Assets

findings.detail: Foreign currency codes were assigned to cost_currency even though the source layout shows those codes preceding Par Amount /Units while Cost (3) is a separate column.

rationale: FX03 is a real error. In the source investment schedule, the header orders the columns as Maturity Date, Par Amount /Units, Cost (3), and Fair Value; the foreign currency token appears between maturity date and the par amount, while the cost value appears two numeric fields later. Representative flagged rows show CAD/EUR/GBP before par amounts (for example CAD 5,953 followed by cost 4,337, EUR 54,814 followed by cost 59,819, and GBP 2,498 followed by cost 3,140). Therefore the pipeline's non-USD cost_currency values are sourced from the par/principal currency position rather than the cost column.
